theme: The Command Center (Swiss High-Contrast / Objective / Functional)
description: A highly professional, confident, data-rich internal Operating System dashboard for e-commerce operations. Avoid generic AI-slop (no purple gradients). It must feel systematic, crisp, precise, and authoritative. Must support seamless LTR/RTL switching and dark/light modes.

typography.primary_font: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, sans-serif
typography.notes: Use strict hierarchical scaling. Arabic requires slightly taller line-heights for legibility. Use logical text alignment utilities (`text-start`, `text-end`) instead of `text-left` or `text-right` to support RTL/LTR.

colors.strategy: Objective, stark, functional. Use white or stark dark backgrounds. Color is used ONLY for status indicators and primary CTAs. Avoid full screen gradients.

dashboard_grid.structure: Base Grid: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`, Tight Gap (`gap-4` or `gap-6`)
dashboard_grid.primary_data: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3 (Main charts, logs)
dashboard_grid.feed_list: col-span-1 row-span-2 (Tall narrow lists like tasks or recent activity)

layouts.rtl_support: CRITICAL: ALWAYS use Tailwind logical properties. `ps-` instead of `pl-`, `pe-` instead of `pr-`, `ms-` instead of `ml-`, `me-` instead of `mr-`, `border-s` instead of `border-l`, `border-e` instead of `border-r`. Set `dir='rtl'` on the HTML tag or wrapper when Arabic is selected.
layouts.sidebar: Responsive sidebar. Sticky on desktop, hamburger on mobile. Must slide from the Right in RTL mode, and Left in LTR mode.
layouts.top_bar: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism or solid background. Contains language toggle, theme toggle, notifications, profile.

components.cards: Subtle roundness (`rounded-lg` to `rounded-xl`). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border (`border-border`), no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (`-translate-y-[2px]`) and `shadow-md`.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (`rounded-md`). Primary buttons use the strict blue color. Interaction animations via `active:scale-95 transition-transform`.
components.inputs: Clean 1px borders, subtle focus ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-background`).
components.navigation: Clear active state using a subtle background block and a left border (or start border in RTL) highlighting the active item.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky headers and floating dropdowns. Dark mode: `bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10`.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton for tabular data. Grid layout with visible internal borders (`border-collapse`, `border-b border-border/40`).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use `lucide-react` for consistent, clean, objective icons. Size 16px to 20px for UI elements.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Subtle fades on mount, slight scales on clicks. No exaggerated bounciness.

motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties, NOT `transition-all`. E.g., `transition-colors duration-200`, `transition-transform duration-200`.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and lists using `framer-motion` if available, or simple CSS animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least AA contrast standards against backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Always provide visible focus indicators for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
accessibility.theme_toggle: Provide explicit UI for Light/Dark mode and LTR/RTL switching.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize logic and modularity. The 'UR SETUP OS' must feel like an extensible operating system.
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Tabs, Dialogs) but strip generic styling to fit the objective 'Command Center' look.
Ensure RTL is implemented using `dir='rtl'` and Tailwind's logical properties (`-s`, `-e`). Never hardcode `ml-` or `pr-`.
Create a responsive Sidebar that works well in both LTR and RTL. In RTL, it should stick to the right edge.
For 'Coming Soon' placeholder pages, maintain consistent layout wrapper, header, and sidebar, and display a clean, centered message.
Avoid using purple gradients or generic SaaS illustrations. Stick to data, metrics, and functional UI.
For the Welcome Banner, display 'صباح الخير' or 'Good Morning' conditionally based on language and time of day.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, crisp borders, and subtle shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous padding inside containers. Use `sonner` for toasts.
Always use modern button styles, pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations.
